brief.claim: In trained athletes, aerobic capacity per kilogram of body mass goes with sprint power per kilogram of body mass: across 30 athletes, the proportion of variance in peak power per kilogram explained by maximal oxygen uptake per kilogram (R squared of a simple linear regression) is at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: maximal oxygen uptake, L/min, from an incremental treadmill test
peak power output in a 10-second cycle sprint, W
